# guix_secrets (Resource)

A logical collection of private files for image or host provisioning. Pass this resource to guix_image.secrets to record dependencies. This version only records descriptors: it neither installs files nor contacts hosts, and has no dependency on SOPS or age. Terraform state contains the file contents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "guix_secrets" "server" {
  files = {
    "/etc/example/private-key" = {
      content = var.private_key
      mode    = "0600"
    }
  }
}

variable "private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Pass secrets = guix_secrets.server to guix_image. This currently records the
# descriptor and dependency only; installation into the image is not implemented.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Attributes Map) Files keyed by absolute destination path. Contents are sensitive and remain outside the Guix source bundle. Files are currently descriptors only; no installation is performed. Future installation defaults to root ownership. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the secret file collection.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `content` (String, Sensitive) File contents, retained as sensitive Terraform state.

Optional:

- `mode` (String) Unix file mode for future installation; defaults to 0600.
